captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a hollow ball-and-socket joint adapter, consisting of a central cylindrical shaft with a larger spherical socket at the bottom and a smaller spherical ball joint at the top. A continuous vertical slot cuts through one side of the entire structure, allowing wires or cables to be easily routed through the hollow core. The top ball joint is truncated flat at its peak, and the bottom socket is similarly truncated flat at its base, creating open entry and exit points.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hollow ball-joint connector in OpenSCAD with a central cylindrical shaft, a larger hollow socket on one end, and a smaller ball joint on the other. Include a continuous side slot for cable routing, and ensure the parameters allow adjusting the shaft height, inner pipe radius, joint radii, and wall thickness.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a boolean difference operation. The base shape is a union of a bottom sphere (large joint), a central cylinder (connecting shaft), and a translated top sphere (small joint). To hollow out the piece, the script differences a central cylinder for the cable passage, concentric spheres for the hollow joint spaces, and translated cubes to slice off the bottom of the large socket and the top of the small ball joint. Finally, a series of translated cubes are subtracted to create the continuous vertical slot along one side.
